create_vertex_ai_rag_ingestion: create a VertexAIRAGIngestion instance to upload files to GCS and import them into a Vertex AI RAG corpus
build_gcs_file_upload: build a GCS file upload using litellm.files.acreate_file with vertex_ai provider and return the GCS URI
run_rag_corpus_import: run a file import into a Vertex AI RAG corpus via the vertexai SDK with configurable chunking strategy
build_transformation_config: build a Vertex AI TransformationConfig from unified chunking_strategy with chunk_size and chunk_overlap settings
store_rag_content: store content in a Vertex AI RAG corpus by uploading to GCS and importing into the specified corpus
